task: How many days are there between February 12, 2024 and August 9, 2050?
answer: FINAL: There are 9,675 days between February 12, 2024 and August 9, 2050. WolframAlpha interprets the input as those dates and shows “9675 days” under Result. Source: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=days+between+February+12%2C+2024+and+August+9%2C+2050 . Screenshot: final.png.
